summary.reasoning: 2 critical CVEs with known RCE exploits (protobufjs, handlebars), affecting core infrastructure and backend. 20+ high-severity CVEs across all primary workspaces. Immediate remediation required.

criticalIssues: handlebars >= 4.0.0 <= 4.7.8 (JavaScript injection via AST type confusion)
vitest < 3.2.6 (arbitrary file read/execution in UI server, GHSA-5xrq-8626-4rwp)

platform/orchestrator.notes: Affects core orchestration infrastructure — HIGHEST PRIORITY

criticalFindings.title: Arbitrary code execution in protobufjs
criticalFindings.description: Remote code execution via protobuf parsing. Code injection through bytes field defaults in generated toObject code.
criticalFindings.notes: Affects orchestrator infrastructure — fix before next production deploy

criticalFindings.title: Handlebars.js has JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion
criticalFindings.description: Multiple critical injection vulnerabilities allowing arbitrary JavaScript execution via AST type confusion, @partial-block tampering, and dynamic partial injection.
criticalFindings.notes: 8 distinct CVEs in handlebars 4.x line — thorough upgrade required

criticalFindings.title: When Vitest UI server is listening, arbitrary file can be read and executed
criticalFindings.description: Vitest UI server lacks authentication, allowing unauthenticated remote code execution and file disclosure when dev server is accessible.
criticalFindings.notes: High risk in CI/CD if dev server is exposed; moderate in local development

highSeverityFindings.title: A malformed request can cause a server crash
vite: server.fs.deny bypass on Windows alternate paths
Open redirect via protocol-relative URL reinterpretation
CRLF injection in form-data via unescaped multipart field names and filenames

phase1_critical_today.expectedOutcome: Eliminate arbitrary file read/RCE in test UI

phase2_high_this_week: Update vite to >= 8.0.16 (path traversal, CORS bypass)
phase4_ongoing_hardening: Enable npm audit fix in CI/CD
